MARS #fabulash eyelashes are the ultimate cherry-on-the-top of any eye look. They are lightweight and perfectly shaped to fit every eye shape and can be used multiple times.
They are a mix of natural and heavy lashes.
You can wear them everyday or in parties.
These lashes have a thin band.
Prepare Your Natural Lashes: Curl your natural lashes and apply mascara before applying false eyelashes. This helps create a base and lift for easier blending with the false lashes.
Trim the False Lashes (if needed): Measure the false lashes against your eyelid and trim any excess from the outer edge if they are too long for your eye shape.

Apply Eyelash Adhesive: Using a small amount of eyelash adhesive (preferably latex-free), apply a thin line along the base of the false lashes. Wait a few seconds for the adhesive to become tacky, which makes it easier to stick to your eyelid.

Position the Lashes: Using tweezers or your fingers, gently place the false lashes as close to your natural lash line as possible. Start from the center of your eye and then press down the inner and outer corners.
Press and Secure: Once the false lashes are in place, gently press along the lash line to secure them. Ensure they are firmly attached and sit comfortably on your eyelid.

Blend with Mascara: After the adhesive has fully dried, gently apply another coat of mascara to blend your natural lashes with the false lashes. This helps create a seamless look and adds extra volume.

Prepare Your Natural Lashes: Curl your natural lashes and apply mascara before applying false eyelashes. This helps create a base and lift for easier blending with the false lashes.
Trim the False Lashes (if needed): Measure the false lashes against your eyelid and trim any excess from the outer edge if they are too long for your eye shape.

Apply Eyelash Adhesive: Using a small amount of eyelash adhesive (preferably latex-free), apply a thin line along the base of the false lashes. Wait a few seconds for the adhesive to become tacky, which makes it easier to stick to your eyelid.

Blend with Mascara: After the adhesive has fully dried, gently apply another coat of mascara to blend your natural lashes with the false lashes. This helps create a seamless look and adds extra volume.
